# FindALocalPro

> Verified home service professionals in DuPage County, Illinois. Every contractor checked against 4 government databases.

## What We Do

FindALocalPro connects homeowners with verified, licensed home service professionals in Downers Grove and DuPage County, IL. Unlike directories that accept paid placements, we verify every contractor against public records before they appear on our site.

## Verification Process

Every pro is checked against 4 databases:
- **IDFPR** (Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation) — State license verification
- **IL Secretary of State** — Business registration and good standing
- **Better Business Bureau** — Rating and complaint history
- **BuildZoom** — Permit history and contractor ranking

Pros that fail verification are not listed. We re-verify monthly.

## Trust Score

Each pro receives a Trust Score (0-100) based on:
- License status: 40%
- Business registration: 25%
- BBB rating: 15%
- BuildZoom score: 10%
- Customer reviews: 10%
